gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with advanced malignant glioma confirmed by histopathology;

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Recombinant NV-A01 adenovirus injection: Patients with advanced glioblastoma were intratumoral injected with NV-A01.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients who have received radiotherapy and/or temozolomide (TMZ) treatment and have residual or recurrent tumors;

agents.drug_class_hint: NV-A01, recombinant adenovirus (oncolytic virus or adenoviral gene therapy), intratumoral

coder_notes: NV-A01 is a recombinant adenovirus given intratumorally: oncolytic virus or viral gene therapy, either way an excluded intervention type; the record does not say which. Conditions name glioblastoma only, but inclusion admits 'advanced malignant glioma', so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named (gbm_only would also include). Peripheral-blood immune pharmacodynamic markers (CD3/CD4/CD8/CD69 T cells, plasma IL2 and IFN-gamma) are planned for NV-A01 but are not tumour molecular biomarkers and the agent is not a candidate.
